_comment: Skills attested by certifications on the resume, sourced from official CompTIA exam objectives. The tailoring script may surface these as cert-backed knowledge when a job description requires them, but never as claimed work experience.

certs.name: CompTIA A+ (Core 1: 220-1101, Core 2: 220-1102)
skills: PC, laptop, and mobile device hardware installation, configuration, and troubleshooting
Hardware components: motherboards, CPUs, RAM, storage devices, power supplies
Printer and peripheral installation, configuration, and maintenance
Networking fundamentals: network types, hardware devices, SOHO network configuration
Virtualization and cloud computing concepts (client-side virtualization, cloud models)
Operating system installation, configuration, and maintenance: Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, iOS
Windows administration: Control Panel, settings, command-line tools, user account management
Security fundamentals: physical security, wireless security (WPA2/WPA3), malware detection and removal
Workstation and data security best practices, screen locks, encryption basics
Software troubleshooting for desktop and mobile OS, applications, and security issues
Operational procedures: documentation, ticketing systems, asset management and inventory tracking, change management
Safety procedures, ESD precautions, environmental controls
Communication skills, professionalism, and customer service in IT support
Basics of scripting (batch, PowerShell, Bash, Python awareness), remote access technologies (RDP, SSH, VPN, VNC)
Backup and recovery methods, disaster prevention

certs.name: CompTIA Network+ (N10-008/N10-009)
skills: OSI model and network protocol analysis
Common ports, protocols, services, and traffic types (TCP/UDP, HTTP/S, DNS, DHCP, SMB, SNMP, syslog)
IP addressing and subnetting (IPv4/IPv6), VLANs, network segmentation
Routing and switching concepts and configuration (static/dynamic routing, STP, trunking)
Wireless networking: standards, device selection, configuration, and security
Network appliances: firewalls, load balancers, proxies, IDS/IPS
Transmission media, transceivers, and structured cabling
Network monitoring technologies, SNMP, flow data, packet capture, log review
Network documentation, change management, and configuration backups
High availability and disaster recovery concepts
Network security: zero trust concepts, defense-in-depth, secure configurations, common attacks and mitigations
Network hardening, access control lists, port security
Systematic network troubleshooting methodology for connectivity, DNS, routing, and performance issues
Command-line network tools: ping, traceroute, nslookup/dig, ipconfig/ifconfig, netstat, tcpdump

certs.name: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
skills: Security controls: technical, managerial, operational, physical
Threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigations: malware, social engineering, application and network attacks
Vulnerability scanning, assessment, and remediation workflows
Security architecture: on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments; IoT and OT considerations
Zero trust architecture and identity-centric security models
Identity and access management: authentication, authorization, MFA, SSO, least privilege, RBAC
Cryptography fundamentals: encryption at rest/in transit, PKI, certificates, hashing
Security operations: monitoring, SIEM concepts, log analysis, alerting and response
Incident response process: detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned
Digital forensics fundamentals and evidence handling
Hardening techniques for endpoints, servers, networks, and mobile devices
Data protection: classification, handling of sensitive data, data loss prevention concepts
Security awareness, policies, and procedures; enforcing established security protocols
Risk management, third-party risk, and compliance concepts (frameworks, audits, attestation)
Security program management, governance, and effective security reporting/communication
Automation and orchestration concepts supporting security operations

certs.name: CompTIA IT Operations Specialist - CIOS (stackable: A+ + Network+)
skills: Attests combined A+ and Network+ skill set: end-to-end IT operations support spanning endpoint hardware/software and network infrastructure

certs.name: CompTIA Secure Infrastructure Specialist - CSIS (stackable: A+ + Network+ + Security+)
skills: Attests combined A+, Network+, and Security+ skill set: securely deploying, operating, and supporting IT infrastructure
